name: task_type
label: Task Type
help: One of your workspace's task types. Its fields appear below once you choose it.

name: title
label: Title
help: Shown in notifications and not encrypted: keep sensitive data out of it. The task type's name when left empty.

name: deadline_minutes
label: Deadline (Minutes)
help: 1 to 525600. The task type's default action applies when it passes. The task type's deadline when left empty.

name: urgent
label: Urgent
help: Marks the task as urgent and starts its email subjects with [Urgent]. It never changes a timer.

name: approvers
label: Approvers
help: Only for task types with open steps: the person for each open step, one entry per person (an open consensus step takes several entries). Leave empty otherwise.

spec.name: step
spec.label: Step
spec.help: The step's number in the task type's chain, from 1.

spec.name: human
spec.label: Person
spec.help: Names only; TaskToHuman never shares addresses.

name: callback_url
label: Callback URL
help: Where TaskToHuman sends the decision for this task, instead of the task type's callback URL. To continue in Make, paste the address shown by Watch Finished Tasks (Instant) in your second scenario.

name: idempotency_key
label: Idempotency Key
help: A value that names this request, such as an order id. Sending the same value again returns the first task instead of asking twice.
